Onbording.title: Welcome to Watch and Learn!
Onbording.descriptionInterface: This determines the language of your interface; what you see on the screen. We recommend choosing English, even if your level is beginner. However, you can skip this step and select your preference later using the interface language switch wich will be available fro you in your profile.
Onbording.discriptionStudy: This determines the language used for explanations and translations. For example, if you want to see the meaning of a word or phrase, it will be translated into language you will choose. Since this is a Ukrainian product, the interface language is currently available in English or Ukrainian only.

Lessons.title: Lessons
Lessons.levelLowDesc: The script appears line by line with some missing words. Instead of the missing words, you will see empty slots. Below each line, you will find possible word options. Your task is to drag and drop the correct word into the correct slot.
Lessons.levelMediumDesc: You need to type the missing word into the blank input field.
Lessons.levelHighDesc: In this version, the script is not visible. You will only see punctuation as a hint. You will see an input field where you need to type the script word by word.
Lessons.step1: Read the lesson description first to understand the context.
Lessons.step2: Start with the Low difficulty level. If it feels too easy, move one level up. If you struggle to find the correct word, try again or choose an easier video.
Lessons.step3: Under the video, you will find Hints & Answers. We recommend trying the exercise before looking at the answer. If you do not understand what a character is saying, try listening several times before checking the answer.
Lessons.step4: If you complete the lesson successfully, by the end you should be able to read the text out loud at the same time as the characters. This technique is called shadowing.
Lessons.noteDesc: The translations in Hints & Answers are not always exact. We prioritize decoding the idea, feeling, or meaning expressed in English over providing a word-for-word translation.
Lessons.exerciseCompleted: Congratulations on completing this step, please move to the next one.

LessonInstructions.title: How does it work?
LessonInstructions.skipForever: I don't need to see the lesson instructions again.
LessonInstructions.step1Body: Read the lesson description before you begin, so you understand the context, who the characters are, what is going on, and what they are talking about.
LessonInstructions.step2Body: In Easy mode, script lines appear one by one. Each line has a blank. Click one of the suggested word options to fill it in.
LessonInstructions.step3Body: Try Medium mode once you've completed Easy, or skip straight to it if Easy feels unnecessary. In Medium mode, some words in the script are missing. Listen to the characters and type the missing words.
LessonInstructions.step4Body: If Hard mode feels too difficult, try Medium or Easy first to prepare yourself. In Hard mode, you need to type each word individually. If the word is correct, it will appear in its place within the script.
LessonInstructions.step5Body: If you've worked through the modes, repeating the sentences you already know should come naturally. Try to get as close to the original as possible, and focus on pronunciation and intonation.
LessonInstructions.step6Body: Read the sentence aloud in English. The sentence will be shown in Ukrainian or Russian, depending on the selected study language. If you can't say it correctly after three attempts, you can reveal the English version.
LessonInstructions.step7Body: Use Hints & Answers if you feel stuck, but try not to look for the answer right away. Give yourself a chance. Play the clip at least three times, and only then check the answer.
